knowledge:
- key_parameters: queryType=Specifies the query mode, either "region" for intronic windows or "SNP" for evaluating variant effects ;; exons=A GRanges object containing exon annotations generated by gtfToExons() ;; filter=Logical; when TRUE in readQueryFile() or makeBranchpointWindowForSNP(), filters out SNPs not located in introns or within 50nt of a 3' exon to optimize processing speed ;; probabilityCutoff=The recommended threshold (0.52) to distinguish branchpoints from non-branchpoint sites ;; BSgenome=A BSgenome object (e.g., BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38) used for sequence retrieval ;; genome=Path to a genome .fa file, used as an alternative to BSgenome ;; bedtoolsLocation=Absolute path to the bedtools binary, required if using a genome .fa file instead of BSgenome ;; useParallel=Logical; set to TRUE in predictBranchpoints() to enable parallel processing and reduce run times
- alternatives: Empirical branchpoint mapping via intron lariat sequencing (e.g., Mercer et al. 2015), which is highly accurate but restricted to highly-expressed genes. branchpointer is preferred for genome-wide predictions across all gene types regardless of expression, or for in silico mutation testing.
- when_to_use: Use when annotating branchpoints in specific introns of interest, or when evaluating how intronic variants (SNPs) might disrupt splicing by altering branchpoint architecture.
- pitfalls: ID format mismatch: Gene, transcript, or exon IDs used in makeBranchpointWindowForExons() must match the exact format in the GTF annotation file (e.g., ENSG00000XXXXXX.X) ;; Chromosome name mismatch: If chromosome names in the .fa genome file do not match those in the query (e.g., "chr1" vs "1"), the rm_chr argument should be set to FALSE ;; Unstranded SNP queries: By default, SNPs retrieved from biomart are unstranded, causing branchpointer to run on both strands, which increases processing time.

workflows.name: intronic_branchpoint_annotation
workflows.intent: Predict and annotate branchpoint probabilities within specified intronic regions.
input: intron_example.txt (tab-delimited table containing query intron coordinates with columns: id, chromosome, start, end, strand)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert GTF annotations to an exon GRanges object using gtfToExons() ;; 2. Read query regions and calculate location attributes using readQueryFile() or generate windows from GTF using makeBranchpointWindowForExons() ;; 3. Predict branchpoint probabilities using predictBranchpoints() ;; 4. Visualize the branchpoint window using plotBranchpointWindow()
workflows.code:
smallExons <- system.file("extdata","gencode.v26.annotation.small.gtf", package = "branchpointer")
exons <- gtfToExons(smallExons)
queryIntronFile <- system.file("extdata","intron_example.txt", package = "branchpointer")
queryIntron <- readQueryFile(queryIntronFile, queryType = "region", exons = exons)
queryIntronFromGTF <- makeBranchpointWindowForExons("ENSE00000939171.1", idType = "exon_id", exons = exons)
branchpointPredictionsIntron <- predictBranchpoints(queryIntron, queryType = "region", BSgenome = g)
plotBranchpointWindow(queryIntron$id[2], branchpointPredictionsIntron, probabilityCutoff = 0.52, plotMutated = FALSE, plotStructure = TRUE, exons = exons)

workflows.name: snp_effect_prediction
workflows.intent: Evaluate the in silico effects of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) on branchpoint architecture.
input: SNP_example.txt (tab-delimited table containing query SNPs with columns: id, chromosome, chrom_start, strand, ref_allele, alt_allele)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert GTF annotations to an exon GRanges object using gtfToExons() ;; 2. Read query SNPs and calculate location attributes using readQueryFile() or fetch SNP attributes from BioMart using makeBranchpointWindowForSNP() ;; 3. Predict branchpoint probabilities for reference and alternative alleles using predictBranchpoints() ;; 4. Summarize the variant effects using predictionsToSummary() ;; 5. Visualize reference vs alternative branchpoint windows using plotBranchpointWindow()
workflows.code:
smallExons <- system.file("extdata","gencode.v26.annotation.small.gtf", package = "branchpointer")
exons <- gtfToExons(smallExons)
querySNPFile <- system.file("extdata","SNP_example.txt", package = "branchpointer")
querySNP <- readQueryFile(querySNPFile, queryType = "SNP", exons = exons, filter = TRUE)
querySNP <- makeBranchpointWindowForSNP(c("rs587776767","rs786205083"), mart.snp = mart, exons = exons, filter  = FALSE)
branchpointPredictionsSNP <- predictBranchpoints(querySNP, queryType = "SNP", BSgenome = g)
querySNPSummary <- predictionsToSummary(querySNP,branchpointPredictionsSNP)
plotBranchpointWindow(querySNP$id[2], branchpointPredictionsSNP, probabilityCutoff = 0.52, plotMutated = TRUE, plotStructure = TRUE, exons = exons)
